title: Renewing the Mind
definition: Renewing the Mind is the Spirit-led transformation of thought, desire, discernment, and obedience through God's truth.
summary: Christian growth includes learning to think according to Scripture.
christFocus: Jesus Christ transforms His people by truth so they discern and do the will of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Renewing the Mind describes a Spirit-formed pattern of life for those who belong to Jesus Christ. Christian living is not an attempt to earn salvation but the grateful response of people who have been saved by grace and called to walk with the Lord.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can grow in holiness, endurance, love, wisdom, worship, and mission. It touches the heart, the mind, the tongue, relationships, daily habits, and faithful obedience in ordinary life.

The emphasis of this doctrine is christian growth includes learning to think according to scripture.. It points disciples away from self-reliance and toward abiding dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because discipleship can become shallow when it is reduced to information, emotion, or outward activity alone. Renewing the Mind teaches believers how grace becomes visible in daily conduct, perseverance, relationships, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to form this truth in you through Scripture, prayer, repentance, and faithful practice. Let renewing the mind shape how you think, speak, serve, endure, forgive, and represent Christ in the places God has assigned to you.
